title: R6M region/join-graph and compressed-tensor construction preflight

program_alignment.central_question: Can two genuinely different bounded-inference families consume the exact D4 factor graph under one matched target and resource contract?
program_alignment.epistemic_role: construction and exact-ceiling prerequisite before approximation-accuracy comparison
upstream_dependencies: R6D exact nonnegative local factor graph
R6L closure of mini-bucket packing optimization
program_alignment.downstream_gate: release a matched physical-marginal accuracy matrix only if both families have valid executable constructions

research_basis.local_scope: Project thesis, WP3 roadmap, Lab 004 R6D-R6L, local Bravyi-Suchara-Vargo tensor-decoder reference, and installed research runtime inspected on 2026-08-29
research_basis.literature_search: targeted primary-source search on 2026-08-29 for iterative join-graph propagation, region graphs, surface-code MPS decoding, and arbitrary-geometry compressed contraction

sources.citation: Mateescu, Kask, Gogate, and Dechter, Join-Graph Propagation Algorithms, JAIR 37 (2010)
sources.design_change: IJGP requires a bounded join-graph decomposition; cluster size controls complexity and ordinary BP is its smallest-i limit.

sources.citation: Yedidia, Freeman, and Weiss, Constructing Free Energy Approximations and Generalized Belief Propagation Algorithms
sources.design_change: region choices and counting/running-intersection validity must be explicit rather than inferred from convergence.

sources.citation: Bravyi, Suchara, and Vargo, Efficient Algorithms for Maximum Likelihood Decoding in the Surface Code, PRA 90, 032326 (2014)
sources.design_change: bond dimension is an explicit approximation-control parameter and must be validated against exact small systems.

sources.citation: Gray and Chan, Hyperoptimized Approximate Contraction of Tensor Networks with Arbitrary Geometry, PRX 14, 011009 (2024)
sources.design_change: use compressed contraction on the irregular D4 tensor network, but separate contraction-path quality from approximation accuracy.

model.common_target: the unadjusted nonnegative R6D/R6F factor-graph partition function on primitive D4 observations
model.region_branch: construct an arc-labeled mini-cluster join graph from each registered elimination order; original factors are assigned once, clusters obey i, and variable-bearing arcs satisfy running intersection
model.tensor_branch: replace each variable hyperedge by an explicit binary COPY tensor, then compare exact contraction with compressed contraction at fixed max_bond
model.fixed_information: same public observation and same exact factor tables; no truth, correction, terminal-sector decision, or new decoder samples

matrix.region_rows: 2 representations x 2 orders x i={10,14} on the registered maximum primitive observation at p=0.10
matrix.tensor_rows: 2 representations x max_bond={2,4,8,exact} on the same graph target
matrix.runtime: project ./run_research_python.sh only; verified NumPy 1.26.4, Quimb 1.13.0, Cotengra 0.7.5, opt_einsum 3.4.0
matrix.budget: under ten CPU minutes and 2 GiB

question.H1: all eight join-graph decompositions pass factor-assignment, scope-cap, arc-label, and running-intersection checks
question.H2: both COPY-tensor representations contract exactly to the independent graph partition function, and every compressed row is finite and deterministic
question.H3: both families pass within budget and therefore release a later matched marginal-accuracy matrix
question.falsification: a missing/duplicate factor, invalid separator, disconnected variable subgraph, scope overflow, exact tensor mismatch, nondeterministic compressed replay, nonfinite result, or runtime violation rejects the affected construction

analysis.comparison: This preflight compares construction validity and bounded executability, not accuracy superiority; no family may be selected from scalar evidence error alone.
analysis.stop_rule: If both pass, register a matched exact-reference marginal matrix covering both families. If one fails, remediate its earliest construction/runtime gate or record it as unavailable; do not silently select the survivor.
analysis.claim_boundary: Construction feasibility on one primitive target only; no posterior-accuracy, decoder, correction, paper-L2, LER, threshold, scaling, or fault-tolerance claim.

acceptance_items.item: bounded join-graph construction and invariant audit
acceptance_items.evidence: 8/8 registered decompositions pass all four invariants

acceptance_items.item: COPY-tensor exact ceiling and compressed deterministic smoke
acceptance_items.evidence: both exact ceilings pass below 1e-15 relative error; unclustered max_bond 4 and 8 reproducibly fail zero-safe QR normalization

acceptance_items.item: machine-readable result, report, Lab/Wiki synthesis, and durable state
